window: Past 24 hours. Search indexes were thin for US federal, military and most local sources; only verifiable items are included.

stories.headline: About a tonne of cocaine found in eight drums at a rural storage site near Santa Marta, with DEA support
stories.body: Colombian police, army mountain troops and anti-narcotics officers, backed by the US DEA, located the drums at a hidden site in the Calabazo area of Bonda, close to Tayrona National Park. Authorities valued the cocaine hydrochloride at over 5.5 billion pesos; no arrests were reported.

stories.headline: Joint forces seize 1,042 kilos of cocaine in Vichada as Meta River offensive passes 2.5 tonnes
stories.body: Colombia's Navy, army, police and prosecutors recovered the cocaine hydrochloride in La Primavera, Vichada, according to the Defense Ministry, which was announced around October 9. The ministry says the river-corridor operations have netted more than 2.5 tonnes in under two weeks; no arrests were reported for this load.

stories.headline: Queensland police tie heroin, meth and cocaine hauls to a courier stop and Gold Coast raids in Operation Yankee Saga
stories.body: A courier was stopped at Marlborough on 9 October carrying 3.1 kg of cocaine and 3 kg of methamphetamine. A search the following weekend at Tanah Merah and Shailer Park turned up about 10.3 kg of heroin, 7.4 kg of meth, 718 g of cocaine and 600 kg of suspected precursor chemicals; two men face charges, with police estimating A$12 million in street value.
stories.quantity: 10.3 kg heroin, 10.4 kg meth, 3.8 kg cocaine
